title: Self-training on the 1,546 unlabelled Egocentric-10K windows
label_source: human, single labeller: labels/ood160_labels.json (160 Egocentric-10K windows, 138 good / 22 bad, 47 factories, q1=60 + q2=100) + labels/manifest_gold.json (150 IndEgo, 100/50)
protocol: factory-grouped StratifiedGroupKFold(5, shuffle, seed=0) OOF; per-domain z-score (unsupervised target mean/std); sign from IndEgo gold; factory-grouped bootstrap 95% CI (n_boot=2000, seed=0) on the OOF scores; paired grouped bootstrap for gains. No OOD threshold tuning (0 for signed-z, 0.5 for probs).
device: CPU (numpy/sklearn, OMP_NUM_THREADS=2; no GPU, no decode)
protocol_self_train: For each outer grouped fold, pseudo-label the unlabelled windows whose factory is NOT in the test fold, using the zero-shot IndEgo-signed stable-8 z-score; add the confident ones to the train set; retrain; evaluate on the held-out factories.

blocks.method: pseudo-label unlabelled 1546 (test factories excluded), retrain logistic
